name: AI Audio Generator
description: Generates audio MP3 files from nodes using AI Text-to-Speech, with chunking and Batch API to handle large content without timeouts.

suggests.google/cloud-text-to-speech: Required for direct Google Cloud TTS integration, bypassing the AI Core provider abstraction.
suggests.cloudconvert/cloudconvert-php: Required for optional WAV-to-MP3 compression via CloudConvert after audio generation.

project_description: AI Audio Generator converts a node's rendered text into a single spoken-audio file (MP3, or WAV compressed to MP3) using either an AI Core text-to-speech provider (OpenAI, Google Gemini, ElevenLabs, etc.) or a direct Google Cloud TTS integration. It renders the node through a dedicated 'Text to Speech' view mode so a site builder controls exactly which fields are read aloud, splits the extracted text into sub-800-character chunks at paragraph then sentence boundaries, and generates each chunk through Drupal's Batch API so arbitrarily long content never hits provider character limits or PHP timeouts. Per-chunk audio is concatenated in pure PHP (stripping ID3/VBR frames from MP3, rebuilding a single RIFF/WAVE header for WAV) into one file that is saved as a managed File, wrapped in a Media entity, and attached to the node via a configured media reference field. A pronunciation dictionary lets editors fix mispronunciations using validated SSML phoneme substitutions (for Google TTS) or plain-text substitutions (for AI providers), and an optional CloudConvert step compresses WAV output to MP3. Content editors trigger generation with a 'Save and generate Audio' button added to the node form.
